newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank fears impact of CPMF tax on stocks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank fears impact of CPMF tax on stocks.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank director Gustavo Franco said he was concerned about the effects of the so-called CPMF cheque tax on foreign investment in local stocks under Annex Four rules, O Globo newspaper said.
The CPMF cheque tax, which would levy 0.2 percent on all financial transactions and is aimed at funding health services, will take effect next year.
According to the newspaper, Franco fears that the tax will encourage foreign investors to trade abroad instead of trading on the local bourses.
"We have to find a way to avoid it," Franco was quoted as saying.
He said the government has been discussing the issue.
Annex Four regulates foreign investment in Brazilian stocks, debentures and privatization bonds.
